subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Worthless
solution: The correct answer is** 'Productive'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word** 'Worthless'** is **'Productive'.** • **Worthless**: having no value or use. [बेकार, किसी काम (या दाम) का नहीं, व्‍यर्थ का] • *Example: It’s **worthless**—it’s only a bit of plastic!* • **Productive**: that makes or grows something, especially in large quantities. [उत्‍पादित या उत्‍पन्‍न करने वाला (विशेषतः बड़े परिणाम में); उत्‍पादनकारी] • *Example: The company wants to sell off its less **productive** factories.* **Correct Answer:__** *Productive.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Insult**: to speak or act rudely to somebody. [(किसी का) अपमान करना] • **Kind**: a group whose members all have the same qualities. (समान गुणों वाले व्यक्तियों का समूह; वर्ग) • **Ineffective**: not producing the effect or result that you want. (जो अभीष्‍ट प्रभाव या परिणाम उत्‍पन्‍न न करे; निष्‍प्रभावी) 35:T6f6, The correct answer is **'feels very proud'.**
